data.content:
* * *

## [Disappointing delivery service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69ffe48906ac5e581d431f64)
The delivery experience was very disappointed. The shipping company tried to deliver my dresser two times, and it both end up with "they need one more helper" since I placed the order. Obviously the second time delivery didn't received any note from the first time. The delivery guy told me that someone will call me to reschedule the delivery again. Unfortunately, I haven't received any call, email or test messages yet. No one contact me.

May 8, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 11, 2026

Hello,

We're sorry to hear about the delivery scheduling issues you've encountered. Our Customer Support team is currently in contact with the freight carrier, and a credit toward a future order has been issued as a gesture of goodwill. They will follow up with you shortly regarding the rescheduling of your delivery.

Lulu and Georgia
